subject: basic-computing
title: Model Question Paper 2
meta: Time: 2 hours · Maximum marks: 40 · Modelled on the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: All questions are compulsory and carry marks as indicated against each question.
Questions 1–8 carry 1 mark, questions 9–16 carry 2 marks, questions 17–20 carry 3 marks and question 21 carries 4 marks.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: On which tab do you find the commands to set margins?
questions.answer: The Page Layout tab.

questions.q: In which bar is the address of the active cell displayed?
questions.answer: The Name bar (Name box).

questions.q: Which button changes the type of a chart on a slide?
questions.answer: Change Chart Type on the Design tab.

questions.q: State true or false: Secondary memory is temporary storage.
questions.answer: False; secondary memory is permanent storage.

questions.q: What is the shortcut key to send an e-mail?
questions.answer: Ctrl + Enter.

questions.q: Write the URL used to create a blog in the lesson.
questions.answer: www.blogger.com.

questions.q: Name the process in which electronics are sold again at lower prices.
questions.answer: Refurbishing.

questions.q: What is the importance of SWAYAM portal?
questions.answer: It ensures equity and quality in education by giving courses (school to post-graduate) with content, video and quizzes anytime and anywhere.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: Write the steps to save a document in MS Word for the first time.
questions.answer: Step 1: Click File, Save As. Step 2: Click Browse and choose the drive and folder. Step 3: Type the file name in the File Name box. Step 4: Click Save.

questions.q: Write the steps to open an existing workbook.
questions.answer: Start, MS Office, MS Excel; File, Open; browse to the location; select the workbook and click Open (or double-click).

questions.q: Write the steps to insert audio and video in your presentation.
questions.answer: Audio: Insert tab, Audio, Audio on My PC, select file, Insert. Video: Insert tab, Video, Video on My PC, select file, Insert.

questions.q: Write advantages of cloud storage (any four).
questions.answer: Anytime anywhere access, backup and recovery, security with login, cost saving, easy sharing and collaboration.

questions.q: What is the difference between CC and BCC?
questions.answer: CC sends a visible copy to another person; BCC sends a copy whose recipients are not visible to others.

questions.q: Write the steps to post a tweet.
questions.answer: Log in to Twitter, type the message in the What's happening box (add a photo, GIF or video if needed) and click Tweet.

questions.q: How do mercury and plastic material found in E-waste harm the human body?
questions.answer: Mercury causes respiratory disorders and brain damage; plastics react with air and moisture, damage the immune system and cause stress and anxiety.

questions.q: How does an E-service help the service provider?
questions.answer: It saves cost of infrastructure, staff, transport and paperwork, allows speedy delivery and easy expansion of services.

sections.title: Answer the questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Explain the different alignments and the page orientations.
questions.answer: Text can be Left, Center, Right or Justify aligned. Portrait page is taller than wide; landscape page is wider than tall; both are set in Page Setup.

questions.q: Explain the benefits of cloud storage.
questions.answer: Usability and accessibility; recovery as backup; security through login; cost saving; easy sharing with permissions; automatic data backup; and collaboration by multiple users in real time.

questions.q: Explain the acts that come under cyber crime.
questions.answer: Online fraud such as credit card theft, copyright infringement, defamation, cyber stalking and bullying, violation of business trade secrets and identity theft.

questions.q: Explain the key to excellent customer service.
questions.answer: Courteous handling and immediate response retain customers; follow up until resolution; know the product and policies; speak slowly and calmly; keep questions short.

sections.title: Word-processing task: write the steps for each part.

questions.q: A list of subjects is typed in MS Word: English, Maths, Science, Computing. Write the steps to (a) make it a bulleted list, (b) change it to a numbered list, (c) check the spelling of the document, (d) copy the list and paste it below.
questions.answer:
(a) Select the list, click the arrow near Bullets and choose a bullet.
(b) With the list selected click the arrow near Numbering and choose a style.
(c) Review tab, Spelling and Grammar (F7), accept suggestions with Change or Change All.
(d) Select the list, click Copy, click below the list and click Paste.
